# Engine test fixtures

`ghost-t1-failed-fit.npz` is an unchanged copy of Ghost Scale Simulation's
published constructed-world T1 numerical failure input:
`results/v23/twin-profile-review-20261017/T1_FAILED_FIT_INPUTS_points.npz`.
SHA-256: `b9d79cd4184249e0e9764f06a1e8ed8a687486614bf9d483d88487568c83ec5e`.
It is numerical regression evidence, not personal data or research admission.

`packets/preview-entries.json` is generated by the real packet builder with a
declared software-test goal backend and three invented short sentences. It tests
strict field parity, separate goal lenses and UI transport. Its candidate ratings
are test values, never presented as a demo reading or validation of inference.
Global findings are the separately attributed aggregate handoff snapshot.
